meta.title: Add multiple budget categories in one budget and delete one
gaps: Open the Budget Creation page and Budget Category List tab.
Create two budget categories with Category Name, Budget Allocated, and Budget Spent values.
Delete one category and verify only the retained category and its balances remain.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the Budget Creation page and Budget Category List tab.; Create two budget categories with Category Name, Budget Allocated, and Budget Spent values.; Delete one category and verify only the retained category and its balances remain.

args.need: on the Budget Category List page, add two categories with names and budget allocated/spent values, delete one category, and verify the list shows only the retained category with its balances

steps.note: The catalog has no budget category controls or assertions, so tester interaction is required to exercise and verify this subject.
Provides a final assertion that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid values.
